reference_date_rule: newest Record Last Updated in the new release (no wall clock)

rules.capacity_rule: blank or non-numeric capacity is unknown (null), never zero
rules.operator_change_rule: operator differs after names.operator_key; cosmetic differences counted, not emitted

caveats: Events are derived from two official DESNZ REPD releases; a REPD status change records when the register was updated, which can lag the real-world decision.
Blank REPD capacity is unknown (null), never zero.
Headlines are generated from REPD fields only; they carry no commentary on any company.

Data-centre proximity is straight-line screening from the convergence join; it is not a grid connection, capacity, offtake or planning link. Data centres are a separate category and never carry a REPD Ref ID.
Relevance is an additive, rule-based score for a solar, storage and grid business; every component is shown and the profile is versioned.
